vibe.verdict: A strong Victorian ball with pounds, shillings and pence and the right Cratchit and Fred dishes, but the poster sits in a box with black bars above and below.
missing: Marley's chains and face in the door knocker (Scrooge's door)
Tiny Tim: 'God bless us. Every one.' (Cratchit table)
Ignorance and Want under the Ghost of Christmas Present's robe
The flying carriage with the Ghost of Christmas Yet to Come
Scrooge at Fred's: 'I've, uh...come to dinner. If you'll have me.'
ideas: Fix the poster crop so it fills the frame without the black bars
Swap 'Hot spiced milk with nutmeg' note for 'God bless us, every one'
Replace 'Potted shrimp with hot toast' note with 'If you'll have me' (Scrooge at Fred's)
Swap 'Brown butter roast chestnuts' for a 'Bah! Humbug!' mustard toast
